name: Pinball Arcade: Doctor Who
storyline: Doctor Who (1992) is a unique table inspired by the longest running Science Fiction TV Show, Doctor Who. Featuring the original Doctor Who theme song, TARDIS, Doctors, companions, and villains from the series, this innovative game, designed by Barry Oursler and Bill Pfutzenreuter, tasks the player with rescuing each of the original 7 Doctors from the Master, each one adding a new dimension to the ruleset. Multiball is played via a 3 level Time Expander mini playfield that raises up to reveal more targets, allowing players to defeat Davros and his Daleks and restore Earth's time to normal. The Doctor is in! 7,752 units of this table were produced.
